hero.headline: I make AI work for Algerian business — in Darija.
hero.subheadline: Co-founder of Algeria Business Bay. Launch partner for the AI labs shipping the tools. I test new models the week they launch, then show what actually works.

cards.title: AI explained in Darija
cards.body: Hands-on breakdowns of the newest models and tools, tested on real projects, for Algerian and MENA entrepreneurs.

cards.title: Launch partner in MENA
cards.body: Dedicated launch videos in Algerian Darija across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, scripted, produced and delivered by my team.

cards.title: Talks and workshops
cards.body: What AI changes for Algerian companies, in plain words, with live demos. Keynotes, panels and practical sessions in Darija, French or English.

abb.body: A private community for business in Algeria: real answers and the right people, whether you run a company in Algiers, sell across the wilayas, or invest from abroad. Built with Larbi, for people who do business here.

paragraphs: I started in 2013 as a freelance graphic and web designer, then spent years inside agencies learning how brands get attention.
In 2023 I went all in on AI, and on explaining it in the language most of our market actually speaks: Darija.
Today I build Algeria Business Bay with Larbi, work with AI labs on their MENA launches, and speak about what AI really changes for Algerian companies.
